prompt_md: An ant walks on the surface of a 10 cm cube, from one corner to the opposite corner. What's the length of its shortest possible path, in cm?
prompt_short: Ant on a 10 cm cube, corner to opposite corner. Shortest path?
explain_intuition_md: Walking the edges takes 30 cm, but the ant can cut across faces. Unfold two neighbouring faces into a 10 by 20 rectangle and the best path is its diagonal.
